meaning_en: Devil or demon; used widely as an expletive equivalent to 'fuck', 'shit', or 'damn'.
usage_context: Universal Bisaya curse expressing extreme frustration, anger, or shock. In casual Davao youth slang, can express astonished emphasis.
offensive_usage_example: Yawa ka, ngano man nanghilabot ka?
benign_usage_note: Literal archaic theological references to Satan; occasional affectionate interjection among close male peers when surprised ('Grabeha, yawa!').

meaning_en: Pestilence, plague, or vermin; used as an expletive equivalent to 'damn it' or 'bastard'.
usage_context: Common expletive shouted in indignation, irritation, or disgust.
offensive_usage_example: Pisti kang dako, ikaw diay nagbuhat ana!
benign_usage_note: Literal agricultural reference to crop pests or biological infestation ('naay pisti sa humay').

meaning_en: Plague-ridden devil; compound expletive equivalent to 'goddamn piece of shit'.
usage_context: Intense compound curse reserved for severe outrage, combat, or heated disputes.
offensive_usage_example: Pisteng yawa ka, ayaw na diri balik!
benign_usage_note: No non-offensive colloquial usage.

meaning_en: Stricken with avian cholera/liver plague; used as 'damned' or 'curse you'.
usage_context: Derived from 'atay' (liver disease in poultry). Expresses intense exasperation or hostility toward an opponent.
offensive_usage_example: Giatay kang tawhana ka, limbongan kaayo ka!
benign_usage_note: 'Atay' by itself is the anatomically correct term for animal or human liver ('atay sa manok').

meaning_en: Your mother's vagina; equivalent to 'son of a bitch' or 'motherfucker'.
usage_context: Extremely grave maternal profanity used to humiliate, provoke fights, or desecrate family honor.
offensive_usage_example: Bilat sa imong inahan, ayaw ko hilabti!
benign_usage_note: Inherently offensive; zero benign conversational use.

meaning_en: Female genitalia; cunt / pussy.
usage_context: Used either as an anatomical obscenity or as a sudden expletive of shock and annoyance.
offensive_usage_example: Baho man nag bilat nang bayhana na.
benign_usage_note: No non-vulgar usage in contemporary Bisaya.

meaning_en: Male genitalia; cock / penis.
usage_context: Obscene vulgarity hurled in arguments or sexualized cyberharassment.
offensive_usage_example: Gamay og oten si Dodong!
benign_usage_note: May appear in childish colloquial anatomy references or urology discussions.

meaning_en: Sexual intercourse; to fuck / copulate.
usage_context: Explicit sexual vulgarity used in insults, harassment, and lewd comments.
offensive_usage_example: Mag-iyot ra man mog huna-huna diha!
benign_usage_note: No benign usage outside explicit adult content.

meaning_en: To fuck; sexual penetration.
usage_context: Crude sexual verb used as an abusive exclamation or vulgar taunt.
offensive_usage_example: Kayata nimo oy, pildi na sad ta!
benign_usage_note: In some remote dialects can mean spread open, but modern digital usage is strictly sexual/expletive.

meaning_en: Slut, whore, or prostitute.
usage_context: Heavily derogatory misogynistic slur targeting a woman's sexual conduct or perceived promiscuity.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw pagtinanga diha, mura kag burikat!
benign_usage_note: Inherently defamatory gendered slur.

meaning_en: Attention whore; provocative flirt; slut.
usage_context: Popular youth slang in Davao and Visayas for someone desperately seeking male sexual attention or flaunting themselves.
offensive_usage_example: Sige kag post og hubag, pampam kaayo ka.
benign_usage_note: May occasionally refer to sound onomatopoeia in nursery contexts, but in adolescent chat it is almost exclusively derogatory.

meaning_en: Rotten egg; stupid, brainless, or incompetent person.
usage_context: Ubiquitous Bisaya insult directed at poor performance, bad decisions, or gaming blunders.
offensive_usage_example: Nganong gi-feeding nimo, bugok ka man diay!
benign_usage_note: Literal culinary term for an unfertilized or spoiled spoiled egg ('bugok nga itlog').

meaning_en: Dumb, stupid, idiot.
usage_context: Direct insult questioning mental faculties.
offensive_usage_example: Bogo kaayo kag desisyon sa duwa.
benign_usage_note: Capitalized 'Bogo' is a major city in Northern Cebu (City of Bogo). Content filter must not flag proper noun matches in geographical contexts.

meaning_en: Crazy, silly, foolish, or half-witted.
usage_context: Used either harshly in arguments or playfully between friends to call out ridiculous behavior.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw sigeg samok diha amaw ka!
benign_usage_note: Often used in lighthearted banter among barkada ('Amawa nimo bay oy haha').

meaning_en: Moron, idiot, or foolishly obstinate person.
usage_context: Denotes someone lacking common sense or acting senselessly stupid.
offensive_usage_example: Hanggaw man ka, ngano imong gibilin ang pultahan abli?
benign_usage_note: Exclusively an insult.

meaning_en: Lacking a screw; mentally deficient or neurodivergent insult.
usage_context: Derogatory term mocking someone by comparing them to a person with an intellectual disability or mental disorder.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw patola na, kuwang-kuwang na iyang utok.
benign_usage_note: Literal 'kuwang' means lacking or insufficient change in money transactions ('kuwang og singko pesos').

meaning_en: You are crazy / mad / insane.
usage_context: Common provocation or harsh reaction to bizarre conduct.
offensive_usage_example: Buang ka ba, pataka man kag pamalikas!
benign_usage_note: Can be colloquial exclamation of disbelief ('Buanga nindota sa sakyanan!').

meaning_en: I will kill you.
usage_context: Direct violent threat communicating intent to murder or commit lethal bodily harm.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw na pakita diri kung di ka gusto nga patyon tika!
benign_usage_note: Unacceptable in all user safety policies; zero benign usage in online public interaction.

meaning_en: I will shoot you with a firearm.
usage_context: Explicit deadly threat specifying firearm violence.
offensive_usage_example: Pusilon tika sa agtang kung mosumbong ka.
benign_usage_note: Zero benign usage.

meaning_en: I will stab you.
usage_context: Explicit threat of bladed weapon assault.
offensive_usage_example: Dunggabon tika diha karon dayon!
benign_usage_note: Zero benign usage.

meaning_en: I will hack/machete you.
usage_context: Threat of machete or bolo slashing.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw sigeg gara-gara kay tigbason tika og sundang!
benign_usage_note: In agriculture 'tigbas' refers to cutting grass or clearing weeds with a bolo.

meaning_en: I will beat / strike you with a club or stick.
usage_context: Threat of physical battery and violence.
offensive_usage_example: Bunalan tika og kahoy diha ron!
benign_usage_note: Can be used in traditional disciplinary warnings by parents, but in peer-to-peer discourse constitutes an assault threat.

meaning_en: I will burn down your house.
usage_context: Arson threat used in severe harassment or territorial disputes.
offensive_usage_example: Hulat lang diha kay sunogon nako inyong balay karong gabii!
benign_usage_note: Zero benign usage.

meaning_en: You are gay / faggot (used derogatorily to mock courage or masculinity).
usage_context: While 'bayot' is the neutral Bisaya word for gay man, weaponizing it as an insult ('bayot ka', 'talawit nga bayot') constitutes homophobic harassment and gender-policing.
offensive_usage_example: Mahadlok ka moaway kay bayot man ka!
benign_usage_note: 'Bayot' is the standard non-pejorative identifier in the Visayas for a homosexual male. Only flagged when syntactically combined with aggressive insult markers.

meaning_en: Effeminate / queer slur.
usage_context: Pejorative slang mocking effeminate male mannerisms.
offensive_usage_example: Tan-awa nang naglakaw, mura mag agi!
benign_usage_note: Homonym: 'agi' standard verb meaning 'to pass by' or 'trace/path' ('niagi ko sa karsada'). Strict word-sense disambiguation required.

meaning_en: Extremely stupid / completely carried (in competitive gaming).
usage_context: Mindanao and Davao esports trash talk accusing a teammate or opponent of having zero skill and needing to be carried.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw na pag-rank kay bogo kargado ra ka pirmi!
benign_usage_note: Gaming slang; non-violent but toxic sportsmanship.

meaning_en: Freeloader on parents / useless parasite living off mom and dad.
usage_context: Taunt directed at opponents in multiplayer games or internet debates, mocking their socioeconomic worth and dependence.
offensive_usage_example: Hilom diha bay, pabuhi ra ka sa ginikanan!
benign_usage_note: Zero benign usage in chat arguments.

meaning_en: Crybaby; sore loser.
usage_context: Widely used in Davao and Visayan gaming servers (borrowed into Tagalog/Bisaya code-switching) to mock complaining players.
offensive_usage_example: Pildi ra gani, iyakin na dayon!
benign_usage_note: Mild teasing or describing an infant.

meaning_en: Prone to crying; whiny person.
usage_context: Traditional Bisaya equivalent of crybaby used to invalidate frustration or legitimate complaints in chat.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw sigeg yawyaw diha, hilakon kaayo ka!
benign_usage_note: Describing young children or sensitive emotional reactions without malice.

meaning_en: You are such a loser / you suck at this.
usage_context: Direct post-match taunting to demoralize opponents.
offensive_usage_example: Pildiha nimo oy, undang na og duwa!
benign_usage_note: Can be friendly post-game banter among established teammates.

meaning_en: Curse derived from Spanish 'leche' (milk); equivalent to 'damn it' or 'crap'.
usage_context: Expletive of frustration, irritation, or sudden mishap.
offensive_usage_example: Litse kang tawhana ka, nasunog na ang niluto!
benign_usage_note: 'Leche flan' (dessert) is benign; filter must permit Spanish food names.

meaning_en: Lightning strike / lightning bolt; used as a curse wishing one be struck dead by lightning.
usage_context: Common profanity expressing deep spite or anger.
offensive_usage_example: Linti ka, ayaw ko limbongi!
benign_usage_note: Archaic meteorology references to lightning or thunderbolts.

meaning_en: Souls in purgatory (Spanish 'ánimas'); exclamation of shock or frustration.
usage_context: Expletive when something goes wrong or when startled.
offensive_usage_example: Animas ka, nakuyawan ko nimo!
benign_usage_note: Catholic religious prayer bells for the souls in purgatory (Ánimas).

meaning_en: You are a beast / animal (dehumanizing insult).
usage_context: Dehumanizing invective leveled at someone behaving without morals, manners, or basic decency.
offensive_usage_example: Animal ka, gibiyaan nimo imong pamilya!
benign_usage_note: Literal biological references to kingdom Animalia ('mga mananap o animal').

meaning_en: Lacking judgment, conscience, or maturity; foolish child.
usage_context: Admonishment targeting a person's complete lack of common decency, discretion, or responsibility.
offensive_usage_example: Tiguwang ka na pero walay buot gihapon ka!
benign_usage_note: Used objectively to describe toddlers who have not yet reached the age of reason.

meaning_en: Ill-mannered; uncouth; having zero morals.
usage_context: Sharp condemnation of disrespectful, rude, or arrogant behavior in public forums.
offensive_usage_example: Bastuso kaayo ka, way batasan gyud!
benign_usage_note: Exclusively an insult.

meaning_en: Boaster, braggart, arrogant show-off.
usage_context: Insult targeting conceited or boastful users in chat and gaming.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw sigeg hinambog diha, hambugero kaayo ka!
benign_usage_note: Can be friendly teasing among close friends.

meaning_en: Stinky feet (used as a demeaning personal hygiene insult).
usage_context: Playful to insulting taunt used in schoolyard and chat banter.
offensive_usage_example: Hilom diha baho kag tiil!
benign_usage_note: Literal podiatry or hygiene discussions.

meaning_en: Bad breath / foul-mouthed gossip.
usage_context: Insult attacking both literal oral hygiene and figurative malicious gossiping.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw ko duoli kay baho kag baba!
benign_usage_note: Dental care discussions.

meaning_en: Backbiter, slanderer, malicious gossip.
usage_context: Condemnation of someone who talks behind others' backs.
offensive_usage_example: Mao gyud na siya, libakero kaayo basta wa ka.
benign_usage_note: Descriptive of gossiping behavior.

meaning_en: From the mountains; used pejoratively as 'primitive hillbilly' or 'uncivilized bumpkin'.
usage_context: Used in urban centers (Cebu City, Davao City) to disparage rural dwellers or indigenous peoples as uncultured or uneducated.
offensive_usage_example: Ayawg patonto ana niya, taga-bukid kaayo og sinul-oban!
benign_usage_note: Literal geographical designation indicating origin from an upland barangay without derogatory intent.

meaning_en: Derogatory term for Bangsamoro Muslims (historical Spanish 'Moor'), used with pejorative stereotypes.
usage_context: Used by non-Muslims in heated communal, political, or land disputes to demean Muslim Filipinos.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw saligi na sila kay mga moros na!
benign_usage_note: 'Moro' / 'Bangsamoro' has been officially reclaimed and accepted as a political and cultural identity (e.g., BARMM). The pluralized/derogatory syntax in informal slur contexts requires careful semantic disambiguation.

meaning_en: Cripple, lame; used as an insult mocking physical mobility disabilities.
usage_context: Weaponized against slow players or people with physical handicaps.
offensive_usage_example: Dali-a diha bakol, sige kag kalangan!
benign_usage_note: Medical or anatomical description of lameness in veterinary or clinical contexts.

meaning_en: Deaf; used as an insult mocking poor listening or hearing impairment.
usage_context: Shouted at people who fail to heed calls or make voice chat mistakes.
offensive_usage_example: Bungol ka ba, kadaghan nako nitawag nimo!
benign_usage_note: Neutral medical and audiological term for deafness ('amang ug bungol').

meaning_en: Person with a cleft palate or nasal speech impairment; used to mock speech disorders.
usage_context: Derogatory taunt targeting speech impediments or voice-chat audio quality.
offensive_usage_example: Di masabtan imong sulti, mura kag ngongo!
benign_usage_note: Colloquial descriptive term in medical missions for cleft palate patients, though clinical terms are preferred.

meaning_en: Your ass / screw you.
usage_context: Vulgar dismissal equivalent to 'kiss my ass' or 'up yours'.
offensive_usage_example: Lubot nimo, dili ko mosugot sa imong gusto!
benign_usage_note: 'Lubot' is anatomical term for buttocks/anus. In culinary context: 'lubot sa manok' (chicken tail/pygostyle, a popular street food).

meaning_en: Lackey, minion, lapdog of a powerful person.
usage_context: Disparaging label in political discussions and corporate disputes for subservient sycophants.
offensive_usage_example: Ayaw patuo ana kay bata-bata ra na sa mayor!
benign_usage_note: Can colloquially refer to small children playing or toys in childcare contexts.

meaning_en: Chronic masturbator; wanker.
usage_context: Crude sexual insult mocking a man's maturity or sexual frustration.
offensive_usage_example: Salsalero kaayo ka, walay tarong nahibaw-an!
benign_usage_note: 'Salsal' in blacksmithing means hammering or forging metal, but in modern colloquial speech it is exclusively sexual.

meaning_en: Clown, buffoon, goofy trickster.
usage_context: Mild insult or teasing directed at an unreliable prankster.
offensive_usage_example: Kolokoy gyud ka, gipatuo ko nimo!
benign_usage_note: Common affectionate teasing among peers and comedic characters.

meaning_en: Abbreviation of 'yawa' (devil/fuck).
usage_context: Vowel-stripped chat abbreviation used in fast text chat, SMS, and in-game messaging.
offensive_usage_example: Pildi na sad ywa jud!
benign_usage_note: Zero benign usage.

meaning_en: Abbreviation of 'giatay' (damned/avian plague).
usage_context: Shortened texting abbreviation to quickly vent anger in chat.
offensive_usage_example: Gty kaayo ang ping sa server!
benign_usage_note: Zero benign usage in chat.

meaning_en: Leetspeak obfuscation of 'yawa' (devil/fuck) substituting '4' for 'a'.
usage_context: Deliberate evasive spelling designed to bypass naive regex and keyword profanity filters.
offensive_usage_example: Y4w4 k4 ayaw pamakak!
benign_usage_note: Zero benign usage; strictly filter evasion.
